corrections.current: FFLOS US 53 (Sandwich/Camp Edwards Army Base #1 Tower Site)
corrections.proposed: Remove FFLOS US 53 from this record. Give the Camp Edwards site its own record.
corrections.why: FFLOS describes a 35-foot wooden tower on the army base, used 1938 through 1960 and taken down when the range closed. It is not the standing 75-foot tower that NHLR US 623 registers.
The September 4, 2008 registration belongs to the Camp Edwards site (US 53), not to the Telegraph Hill tower.

corrections.current: Sandwich/Camp Edwards Army Base #1 Tower Site
corrections.why: That name is the FFLOS title for the separate Camp Edwards site.

The NHLR coordinates fall on Shawme-Crowell State Forest, the location the register and the state document give. The OSM point is about 8 km northwest, nearer Camp Edwards. The proposal is not checked on a map.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's 'Built 1966' field refers to the present tower. The 1934 CCC tower it replaced is recorded as a separate built event.
The brief record ties FFLOS US 53 to this tower. The FFLOS page describes a different, removed Camp Edwards tower. The story and the research file treat them as two structures.

notes_for_editor: The NHLR page is the main source for the tower's build history, but it has no visit reports, so no staffing or access data. The Mass.gov section lists the Sandwich Fire Observation Tower as current, but the text read carries no date and says nothing on staffing or public access, so those facts are omitted. The 1938 fire details (three dead, 3,000 to 4,000 acres, the May 6 meeting) come from one local blog, fostasandwich.com. Checking them against a newspaper or the capenews.net and capecodfd.com histories would help; capenews returned HTTP 429 and capecodfd was not read. The brief's coordinates (OSM) and the NHLR coordinates are about 8 km apart; this file uses NHLR, which needs a map check. A May 2023 Cape Cod Times photo caption, seen only as a search snippet, says an observer was on the Sandwich tower then. It is not cited. Not verified: current status, staffing, climbing rules. No photos added.
